cases.request: Write a polite letter to Rivergum Council about the missed recycling collection on Tuesday 12 May at 14 Wattle Street. Ask for collection before Friday and confirmation by email.
Write to Cedar Library asking to renew the community room booking for the Moonleaf Garden Club on 7 June from 6 pm to 8 pm. Ask whether the fee remains $40.
Write a calm letter to Morgan Lee about the leaking kitchen tap at 22 Fern Lane. Say it began on Monday, is wasting water, and ask for a plumber this week.
Write to Principal Asha Patel explaining that Sam Rivera will miss the excursion on 3 August because of a medical appointment. Ask how to receive the worksheet.
Write to Northstar Repairs requesting a refund of $85 for order NR-204 because the repaired lamp stopped working after two days. Ask for a reply within 10 business days.
Write a friendly note to neighbour Elena Cho about loud music after 11 pm on Thursday and Saturday. Mention the baby wakes early and ask to lower the volume after 10 pm.
Write to Harbour Pantry offering to volunteer on Wednesday mornings from September. Mention food-safety training and ask whether the 9 am shift needs help.
Write to Hillside Council about a damaged jacaranda outside 6 Paperbark Road after the storm on 18 January. Say one branch hangs over the footpath and request an inspection.

Write to Juniper Arts Centre asking to move Casey Wong from the pottery class on 4 March to the class on 11 March. Explain that the first date clashes with work and ask if the $25 materials fee transfers.
Write to Blue Finch Furniture about delivery BF-731 scheduled for 16 October. Ask for arrival after 2 pm, a call 30 minutes beforehand, and confirmation that the old table will be removed.
